name: Climb and Jump Tower [NEW WORLD]
desc:
Welcome to Climb and Jump Tower! 

In this thrilling game, you and your friends will tackle daring heights, scaling iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Leaning Tower of Pisa, and the Pyramids. 

How to Play:

🧗Climb Challenges🧗
💰Collect Coins💰
🐦Unlock Wings🐦

How to play:
🧱Build and climb 🧱
👻Complete spooky stages 👻
🌟Earn Golden Brick Tokens🌟

Join our group and like our game, please!
